publishedWorkflows.name: HQC Lead Management - Paid Job Review Check

localValidation.workerdFailingBefore: Valid enquiry returned 502 because workerd rejects redirect:error
localValidation.workerdPassingAfter: 200 for accepted receipt, 502 for redirect with no forwarded second request

humanChecks: Personally contact lead and log outcome
Confirm completed service and real review send before Review Request Sent
Set next action and follow-up date

remainingOutcomeGate.action: Use the next genuine enquiry, contact customer and record outcome plus next follow-up
remainingOutcomeGate.checkBy: Next genuine enquiry or within two working days of handover

limitations: Native duplicate protection is not a durable idempotency ledger or concurrent exactly-once guarantee
No automatic customer acknowledgement, nurture or review send is part of these two new workflows
No booking payment or client adoption outcome is inferred from isolated tests
privateEvidence: Raw provider snapshots, payloads and receiver URLs retained outside repository; no customer data included here
